resources.string: Sign in with an administrator account
You were signed out because this account is no longer an administrator.
Enter an http:// or https:// address, for example https://api.example.com
This is an http:// address. Your password and tokens travel unencrypted.
Generate one in the web console: open Profile from the avatar menu, then Security → Access Token. Regenerating it there invalidates the previous token and signs this app out.
An access token never expires, but some actions need a password sign-in, such as changing your password.
The server rejected this access token. Copy the current token from the web console and try again.
This account has too many active sign-in sessions. Sign out other sessions in the web console (Profile → Login sessions), then try again.
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Enter one of your backup codes.
Each backup code can only be used once.
The verification code must be 6 digits.
The sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.
